name: Dotfield
description: A plain even field: the dot half the width of its tile.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 25%, transparent 25%) 0 0 / 20% 20%; mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 25%, transparent 25%) 0 0 / 20% 20%; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
